image_description: Two compact audio cassettes housed in transparent plastic jewel cases, lying side-by-side on a white surface. The left cassette has a label with pink and orange abstract graphics; the right cassette features a 'K7' logo and colorful vertical stripes. Both cassettes show visible internal spools through the clear casing.

The white oval shape in the center of the left label lacks sharp definition and seems to blend slightly into the background graphics, lacking the distinct edge of a physical sticker.

To verify the structural integrity of the transparent cases and ensure no melting or fusion between the case and the cassette inside.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the right cassette. AI models often struggle with small, dense text on curved or reflective surfaces. Verify if the 'gibberish' is actual nonsense or just low-resolution compression. Also, check if the reflection on the plastic cases is physically consistent with the light source.
